Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Features | National Vlisco launches Vlisco VIBE — A new expression for everyday life Source : Myjoyonline.com 2 November 2026 11:03am Audio By Carbonatix
Global textile brand Vlisco introduces Vlisco VIBE — a fresh take on its iconic prints, made for the contemporary wardrobe.
Where the brand’s distinctive designs have been woven into moments of celebration and ceremony, Vlisco VIBE now extends that legacy into the rhythm of daily life – from professional to casual occasions, season after season.
Launching this October, the inaugural collection of fabrics arrives in vibrant colourways and modern motifs, built for versatile styling.
To bring it to life, Vlisco has partnered with acclaimed Nigerian fashion designer Lisa Folawiyo, whose signature blend of printed textiles and effortless tailoring defines a five-piece capsule designed exclusively for the brand. Sewing patterns for each of Folawiyo’s designs will be available alongside the fabrics, inspiring customers to recreate the styles and make them their own.
Crafted for effortless movement in fine cotton satin, Vlisco VIBE offers breathable comfort and an elegant drape, creating flowing silhouettes at more accessible prices.
The launch collection features four new designs across 18 colourways, available in two- and four-yard pieces supporting versatile styling for contemporary separates.
Vlisco VIBE redefines the role of print beyond special occasions, making it an intuitive part of everyday style. Each design serves as a creative canvas — a starting point for tailoring, layering, and mixing with existing wardrobe pieces.
Designed for modern lifestyles, the collection transitions seamlessly from day to evening, workdays to weekends.
“Vlisco has always invited people to express themselves, especially during life’s most meaningful moments. With Vlisco VIBE, we’re bringing that same creative spirit into everyday moments. Rooted in 180 years of craftsmanship, the collection reimagines our heritage through a fresh, contemporary lens, with versatile prints that feel relevant and easy to make your own. At its heart is something we deeply believe: the creativity of transforming fabric into fashion is worth preserving, celebrating and passing on.”
With Vlisco VIBE, the brand enters a new era of everyday luxury, connecting generations through the power of print while honouring its heritage of craftsmanship, creativity, and cultural expression.
Vlisco VIBE will be available online and in Vlisco retail stores from October 13, 2026.
Discover the Vlisco VIBE collection at vlisco.com/pages/vibe.
Founded in 1846, Vlisco is a heritage textile company renowned for its unique printed fabrics, crafted using time-honoured techniques and exceptional-quality materials.
Across generations, each design is infused with imagination, storytelling, and craftsmanship, creating textiles with a character and spirit of their own.
Vlisco’s history is deeply intertwined with the cultural exchange between the Netherlands and Africa. Its distinctive prints have become cultural treasures, embraced and redefined by generations of African women.
Over time, the fabrics have acquired names, meanings, and deep cultural significance, transforming them into treasured markers of identity, occasion, and community across West and Central Africa.
For 180 years, the brand has continued to push the boundaries of textile design through process-driven innovation, balancing an enduring respect for its heritage with a creative curiosity for what comes next.
Each unique Vlisco print sparks the imagination, celebrates culture and community, and inspires bold, joyful self-expression.
